resources.string: Hideout sends daily app activity and feature results to PostHog in the EU. Events include timing ranges, failure categories, import source manager, app version, and operating system. A random installation ID links repeat use. Turn sharing off in Settings → About.

We measure installs, imports, 3D preview loads, and custom game hosting and joining. We do not send Steam accounts, mod names or IDs, searches, files, invite codes, or recordings. Turning this off stops new collection and clears unsent events. It does not delete events already received.
